Can you help me find the top 5 countries whose players have the highest average of their individual average runs per match across all seasons? Specifically, for each player, calculate their average runs per match over all matches they played, then compute the average of these player averages for each country, and include these country batting averages in the result.

query_id='4-0'

player_id,player_name,dob,batting_hand,bowling_skill,country_name
1,SC Ganguly,1972-07-08,Left-hand bat,Right-arm medium,India
2,BB McCullum,1981-09-27,Right-hand bat,Right-arm medium,New Zealand
3,RT Ponting,1974-12-19,Right-hand bat,Right-arm medium,Australia
4,DJ Hussey,1977-07-15,Right-hand bat,Right-arm offbreak,Australia
5,Mohammad Hafeez,1980-10-17,Right-hand bat,Right-arm offbreak,Pakistan

args.sql:
WITH player_runs AS (
    SELECT
        b.striker AS player_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM ipl.main.ball_by_ball b
    JOIN ipl.main.batsman_scored bs
      ON b.match_id = bs.match_id
     AND b.over_id = bs.over_id
     AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
     AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.striker
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS total_matches
    FROM ipl.main.player_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
player_stats AS (
    SELECT
        p.player_id,
        p.country_name,
        COALESCE(pr.total_runs, 0) AS total_runs,
        pm.total_matches,
        CAST(COALESCE(pr.total_runs, 0) AS DOUBLE) / pm.total_matches AS avg_runs_per_match
    FROM ipl.main.player p
    JOIN player_matches pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
    LEFT JOIN player_runs pr ON p.player_id = pr.player_id
)
SELECT
    country_name,
    AVG(avg_runs_per_match) AS country_avg_runs_per_match
FROM player_stats
GROUP BY country_name
ORDER BY country_avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5;
